ruling.recommended_action: Issue a $5.41 Ryde voucher to the rider for the unexempted 3.84 km off-route segment (RydeTAXI mileage units only) and record the driver's breach of the RD-1 shortest-and-most-direct obligation.
ruling.reasoning:
The trip is RydeTAXI (metered breakdown in F7: base $3.90, distance $18.41, time $5.18, waiting $0.11, platform $1.47, total $29.07), so RD-2's metered branch applies [F7][RD-2]. The trace confirms one off-route segment, F3, 17:34–17:42, 4.84 km driven where the optimal route covers 1.00 km, extra 3.84 km, up to 1421 m off route [F3][RD-1].

On RD-5: the driver asked at 17:31 about going "round via Clementi Road" [F8] and the rider refused in her own timestamped message at 17:31, "No, I'm not okay with that. Please stay on Ayer Rajah Expressway" [F9][F10]. That refusal precedes the 17:34 segment start [F3], and the driver's own statement admits he took the alternative "anyway" [F11]. The chat record is complete and fully timestamped [F10], so no rider agreement before the segment exists: the segment counts under RD-5 [F9][F11][RD-5]. The driver's post-trip assertion of what was discussed is a statement, not consent [F11][RD-5].

On RD-3: no rider-requested stop or named place appears in this segment; the only named place is the driver's proposal, which the rider refused [F8][F9][RD-3]. RD-4 gives no excuse: no incident was recorded near the route during the trip window [F14], and the Ayer Rajah Expressway speed band was 4 (30–39 km/h), not the band 1–2 level RD-4(b) contemplates, with fair weather [F12][F15][RD-4]. The driver's "it was faster" claim is contradicted by 20.3 min actual vs 13.8 min estimated [F2][F11].

Amount: the unexempted segment's extra_km × the trip's per-km rate from the fare record, $18.41 ÷ 13.06 km = $1.40965/km as the trace states [$1.4096/km, F4]; 3.84 km × $1.4096/km = $5.41 [F3][F4][F7][RD-2]. The billed excess-distance item of $6.53 covers 4.63 km of route excess beyond any single segment and, per RD-2, the residual mileage not attributable to an unexempted segment is not refundable [F4][RD-2]. The waiting item is charged per meter waiting units ($0.11, F5) and is not refundable on RydeTAXI [F5][F7][RD-3]; no surge or unpublished add-on is present [F6][F7][FARE-1].

On RD-6: the driver's profile shows route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0, so the "repeated route dispute" precondition is not met and no account referral is added [F17][RD-6]; the breach of the RD-1 duty is nonetheless recorded [F3][RD-2]. Safety screen: all messages, the complaint and the driver's statement read; the exchange is a route disagreement only — no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation [F8][F9][F11][SAFE-1][SAFE-2]. The record is complete (both messages timestamped, F10) and settles every element, so no escalation.

segment_findings.reason: The rider's own timestamped message at 17:31 expressly refused the driver's proposed route via Clementi Road [F9][F8][F10], before the 17:34 segment start [F3], and the driver's post-trip statement admits he took the alternative anyway [F11]. RD-5 therefore grants no consent, the driver's statement is not consent (G11), and no rider message names any place for a stop under RD-3. No RD-4 incident exists [F14][F12]. The 3.84 km extra is an unexempted off-route segment refundable under RD-2 [RD-1][RD-5].

rejected_claims.reason: The requested $6.53 takes F4's billed route excess of 4.63 km, but RD-2 refunds only the extra_km of the unexempted segment, which F3 measures at 3.84 km; the residual mileage (route-corridor miles, matching jitter, the gap between F4 and the segment sum) is expressly non-refundable [F3][F4][RD-2].

The driver's cap of $5.41 on the segment is accepted in result, but his framing that RD-2's refund is 'capped' below the segment value is rejected: $5.41 is the full RD-2 amount (3.84 km × $1.4096/km), not a discount, since F4's $6.53 covers miles outside the segment which RD-2 excludes [F3][F4][RD-2].
Not a claim against the rider's position; the waiting item of $0.11 is metered waiting time (F5) and correctly not refunded under RD-3(c) [F5][F7][RD-3].

Accepted that no RD-6 flag_account arises because F17 shows route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0, but rejected insofar as it suggests no driver breach is recorded: RD-2 records the RD-1 breach whenever a refund is payable [F17][F3][F11][RD-6][RD-2].

Accepted that the deviation is one segment (F3), but rejected insofar as it implies the whole-trip +4.7 km (F1) is irrelevant: F1 and F2 are the recorded size of the deviation and corroborate that the driver's 'it was faster' claim (F11) fails [F1][F2][F11][RD-1].
